bug_outcomes.B1: Candidate insertion verifies byte-boundary prefix proofs before replacement. Shorter prefixes cannot overwrite fuller accepted history; identical bytes can be reparsed and proven extensions can advance. Divergent copies retain accepted facts and set a bounded, persistent same_source_conflict flag exposed through existing canonical conflicts coverage. Conflict-only changes queue projection/revision updates. Reproduction retains 330 tokens, including unchanged refresh and restart.
bug_outcomes.B6: Parser validates optional git, source/subagent/thread_spawn, parent identifier, settings/model/effort, and token-info/usage object shapes. Invalid nested data raises a handled ValueError; optional null/omitted data and string subagent enum variants remain supported. Existing per-file failure handling preserves prior facts/checkpoints, records safe diagnostics, continues healthy files, suppresses unchanged automatic retries, and retries manual refreshes. Reproduction indexes the healthy 110-token session. Unexpected AttributeError defects still propagate.

upgrade_behavior.schema: Idempotently adds candidates.same_source_conflict INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0; keeps existing candidate keys, source IDs, fact format, and transfer schema.
upgrade_behavior.online_sources: The existing parser-version checkpoint mechanism reparses each older physical file once, recovering the fuller history previously hidden by a shorter candidate. Existing transactional checkpoints/projection_queue retain restart and cancellation behavior.
upgrade_behavior.offline_sources: Keep accepted contributions; old checkpoints remain pending and reparse after reconnect. Disabled sources similarly wait until enabled.
upgrade_behavior.imports: Snapshot import/export remains compatible and accepted fuller histories round-trip without private paths. A snapshot that already discarded the longer history cannot recreate missing raw facts; recovery requires the originating files or a corrected snapshot.

design_limits: One accepted history plus a conflict bit is retained per source/segment, rather than unbounded duplicate facts. The warning records observed divergence conservatively and remains across rebuilds even if the divergent file is later removed; forgetting the source removes it.
Same-source conflict diagnostics are local catalog metadata, not new fields in portable facts. Snapshots export the accepted history with no physical-file provenance.
Raw-log rewrite with a divergent prefix is treated conservatively as a conflicting history, retaining previously accepted facts.
required_integration_work: Run combined Python/frontend/browser acceptance after all owners finish; this owner ran scoped synthetic tests only.
Preserve PARSER_VERSION=3 (or a later integrated version) so stale local checkpoints are revisited.
Implement the separately assigned replay-accounting projection upgrade for existing local/imported facts; the parser bump alone cannot reproject imported snapshots.

Document one-time local reparse, offline recovery, and persistent conflict warnings in the shared repair documentation. No transfer-format or projection code change is required by these ingestion fixes.
safety: Only synthetic session fixtures and isolated databases under unique .local-data test directories were used. No original session logs, real credentials, commits, releases, or unrelated-owner files were modified.
